The '''Emperor's Titan''' was the personnel [[Walker/Legends|Walker]] for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vorrel]]. He piloted this walker down the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Advance on [[Arda I]].<ref name="Onslaught at Arda I" />
